sloka: तस्या हि आकृष्यमाणाया मन्थरायाः ततः ततः ।चित्रम् बहु विधम् भाण्डम् पृथिव्याम् तत् व्यशीर्यत ॥२-७८-१७॥
transliteration: tasyā hi ākṛṣyamāṇāyā mantharāyāḥ tataḥ tataḥ ।citram bahu vidham bhāṇḍam pṛthivyām tat vyaśīryata ॥2-78-17॥

translations.english: While Manthara was being dragged by Satrughna, the collection of ornaments of many colours and of various kinds worn by her were broken and scattered here and there all over the ground.
